extraction.text:
RAVI RAJU MANDA

Lead Business Architect (Pega LBA) | Principal Business Analyst

Email: mandaraviraj@gmail.com  Phone: +91- 6304146168  Location: Hyderabad, India

CAREER SUMMARY

Strategic, results-driven, and Pega Certified Business Architect (PCBA) with over 18 years of total professional IT experience, specializing in large-scale digital transformation, workflow orchestration, client onboarding (CLM), KYC frameworks, and Customer Value Management (CDH) decisioning models across global industry sectors including BFSI and Telecommunications. Proven expert in partnering with senior executive stakeholders to run advanced process discovery workshops leveraging Pega GenAI frameworks to accelerate high-impact Pega Blueprint design. Adept at orchestrating predictive analytics, machine learning models, Adaptive Decisioning, and real-time Next-Best-Action (NBA) strategies to optimize customer value journeys and maximize conversion metrics. Extensive success leading cross-functional global agile squads for market leaders like the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA), UBS, and Wipro, maintaining strict adherence to SDLC governance.

KEY SKILLS & TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

Pega Platforms:	Pega Case Management Lifecycle, Workflow Orchestration, Pega CLM, Pega KYC, Pega CDH (Customer Decision Hub)

AI & Data Analytics:	Pega GenAI Tools, Predictive Analytics, Machine Learning (ML) Models, Adaptive Decisioning, Next-Best-Action (NBA) Strategies, Pega Blueprint Ecosystem, AI Accelerators

Methodologies:	Agile/Scrum Leadership, Requirements Elicitation, Target Operating Models, SDLC Governance, Business Process Modeling (BPMN/UML), GAP Analysis

Domain Expertise:	Banking & Financial Services (BFSI), Investment Banking, Corporate Actions, Client Lifecycle Management, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Consumer Goods, e-Governance & Telecom

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Principal Business Analyst / Lead Business Architect (Pega LBA)	Jun 2024 – Till Date

Lantiqx India Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, India ( Client - Commonwealth Bank of Australia)

Project: Risk and Resilience Squad — Enterprise Integration & Governance (Domain: BFSI)

Lead enterprise-level requirement discovery, strategy formulation, and scope management activities across high-impact business process re-engineering and digital transformation initiatives.

Facilitate advanced process discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews leveraging Pega GenAI framework to design optimized future-state corporate business models.

Utilize Pega GenAI capabilities and integrated AI tools to ingest legacy documentation, accelerating the creation of High-Fidelity Pega Blueprints, multi-tiered case stages, and persona mappings.

Translate complex business goals and risk governance strategies into highly scalable functional designs, identifying framework feature variances and aligning with architectural best practices.

Oversee agile sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and operational governance, leveraging AI accelerators to author complex epics, user stories, and comprehensive functional specifications.

Manage secure cross-platform system integrations involving SSH and PGP encryption protocols, resolving environment readiness constraints in collaboration with infrastructure teams.

Standardize organizational change management documentation, creating frameworks for rollback planning, risk categorization, and audit-ready traceability matrices.

Developed Business Capability Maps for Cross-Border Payments, covering payment initiation, validation, routing, processing, exception management, investigation, reconciliation and settlement, and identified capability gaps between current and target states.

Created end-to-end Customer Journey Maps for Cross-Border Payments, analysing customer pain points, manual touchpoints, processing delays and service gaps, and defining future-state journeys aligned with the transformation roadmap.

Assistant Consultant / Lead Business Architect (Pega LBA)	Apr 2022 – Apr 2024

TCS Dubai, Dubai, UAE

Project: Customer Value Management (CVM Greenfield Transformation) — (Domain: Telecommunications)

Spearheaded a business-level greenfield enterprise transformation project replacing legacy tracking structures with Pega Case Management Frameworks and the Pega CDH decisioning platform.

Collaborated with business leaders and technical squads to define taxonomy, engagement policies, and arbitration rules utilizing Pega Customer Decision Hub (CDH) to architect contextual, multi-channel customer journeys.

Drove requirement elicitation for predictive analytics, machine learning (ML) models, and real-time data attribute mapping, establishing optimized parameters for model scoring and data mapping frequencies.

Translated marketing business strategies into functional HLD specifications, overseeing configurations for campaign segments, adaptive decision strategies, contact policies, and offer flow orchestration.

Responsible for functional validation, simulation testing, and fine-tuning predictive and adaptive AI decisioning models to safeguard intended performance outputs and maximize target conversion rates.

Governed cross-functional delivery streams, program estimations, SOW frameworks, resource allocation baselines, and automated dashboard reporting via Jira and Confluence.

Senior Specialist - Business Analysis / Lead Pega BA	Nov 2019 – Feb 2022

L&T Infotech (LTI), India

Project: Mozart Master Data Management System — (Domain: Consumer Goods & Telecom)

Served dual functional leadership roles as Scrum Master and Lead Business Architect for an automated Master Data Management system powered by the Pega Case Management Framework.

Facilitated global requirement elicitation process workshops across multiple European regions (UK, Italy, Nordics, Iberia, Eastern Europe) to design optimized, automated 'To-Be' operational workflows.

Created visually striking prototyping models, structural mockups, and process designs using Agile Workbench to present system flows to corporate executive steering committees.

Directed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies, bug-tracking triages, defect remediation workflows, and designed end-user training documentation and release readiness communication plans.

Senior Business Analyst (Client-Side Consultant)	Dec 2017 – Oct 2019

a- Pragati Authority, Government of AP (via Lakshya IT), India

Projects: e-Admission Lifecycle System & e-Application Ecosystem — (Domain: e-Governance)

Analyzed legacy e-governance systems to drive comprehensive digital transformation and process re-engineering blueprints for cross-department educational platforms.

Authored comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications, and interactive application wireframes utilizing Axure RP for structural executive sign-offs.

Liaised dynamically across state government agencies to orchestrate secure web service API integrations and manage core master data management structures.

Lead Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (Pega CLM & KYC)	Nov 2011 – Sep 2017

Wipro Ltd, India & Australia

Project: Client Onboarding, KYC & Global Regulatory Transformation — (Domain: Investment Banking / BFSI)

Designed and executed high-impact Pega-driven solutions for global corporate onboarding, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and KYC / Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) for international tier-1 clients, including hands-on platform leadership at the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA).

Architected a robust Target Operating Model to standardize customer onboarding journeys, maintenance, and off-boarding compliance workflows globally.

Designed integration specifications for third-party validation engines, configuring data mapping protocols for external data vectors such as World-Check and Markit.

Performed detailed enterprise-wide GAP analysis between current operations and intended automated platform designs; engineered business readiness matrices, data migration checklists, and managed large-scale UAT alignment.

Project: Cross-Border Payments Transformation – [UBS Bank]

Led Business Analysis for Cross-Border Payments transformation involving SWIFT and ISO 20022, working with business, operations, product, compliance and technology stakeholders.

Analysed AS-IS SWIFT payment processes and defined TO-BE ISO 20022 payment workflows, identifying process, data and system gaps.

Defined functional requirements across the end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation, routing, processing, exception handling and settlement.

Conducted SWIFT / ISO 20022 impact and gap analysis and translated business requirements into functional specifications and user stories.

Senior Analyst - Operations	Aug 2007 – Oct 2011

Wipro Ltd, India

Project: Corporate Actions & Income Processing (UBS Account) — (Domain: Investment Banking)

Supervised front-to-back operational workflows, processing complex mandatory and voluntary corporate action events from market-validation through to ultimate asset-entitlement booking.

Formulated corporate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), high-fidelity process maps, and FMEAs to enforce strict alignment with financial risk-mitigation frameworks using Microsoft Visio.

Research Associate - Operations	Mar 2006 – Jul 2007

S&P Global – Capital IQ, Hyderabad, India

Conducted structured analytical extractions of corporate financial statements filed by US and international businesses, formulating programmatic validation logics to ensure zero-defect financial data publishing.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL CREDENTIALS

Mandatory Industry Certification: Pega Certified Business Architect (PCBA)

Professional Certification: Pega Certified Decisioning Consultant (CPDC)

Master of Business Administration (MBA): SCPG College, Kakatiya University

Authored comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications, and interactive application wireframes utilizing Axure RP for structural executive sign-offs.
Liaised dynamically across state government agencies to orchestrate secure web service API integrations and manage core master data management structures.
Lead Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (Pega CLM & KYC)	Nov 2011 – Sep 2017
Wipro Ltd, India & Australia
Project: Client Onboarding, KYC & Global Regulatory Transformation — (Domain: Investment Banking / BFSI)
Designed and executed high-impact Pega-driven solutions for global corporate onboarding, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and KYC / Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) for international tier-1 clients, including hands-on platform leadership at the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA).
Architected a robust Target Operating Model to standardize customer onboarding journeys, maintenance, and off-boarding compliance workflows globally.
Designed integration specifications for third-party validation engines, configuring data mapping protocols for external data vectors such as World-Check and Markit.
Performed detailed enterprise-wide GAP analysis between current operations and intended automated platform designs; engineered business readiness matrices, data migration checklists, and managed large-scale UAT alignment.
Project: Cross-Border Payments Transformation – [UBS Bank]
Led Business Analysis for Cross-Border Payments transformation involving SWIFT and ISO 20022, working with business, operations, product, compliance and technology stakeholders.
Analysed AS-IS SWIFT payment processes and defined TO-BE ISO 20022 payment workflows, identifying process, data and system gaps.
Defined functional requirements across the end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation, routing, processing, exception handling and settlement.
Conducted SWIFT / ISO 20022 impact and gap analysis and translated business requirements into functional specifications and user stories.

Wipro Ltd, India
Project: Corporate Actions & Income Processing (UBS Account) — (Domain: Investment Banking)
Supervised front-to-back operational workflows, processing complex mandatory and voluntary corporate action events from market-validation through to ultimate asset-entitlement booking.
Formulated corporate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), high-fidelity process maps, and FMEAs to enforce strict alignment with financial risk-mitigation frameworks using Microsoft Visio.
Research Associate - Operations	Mar 2006 – Jul 2007
S&P Global – Capital IQ, Hyderabad, India
Conducted structured analytical extractions of corporate financial statements filed by US and international businesses, formulating programmatic validation logics to ensure zero-defect financial data publishing.
